title: THE CRITIQUE — sculptor reviews the dissolution
method: critique not critic. the sculptor turns the pot, looks from every angle, finds where the glaze pooled and where the wall is thin.

sculpt.what: carved 474 surfaces down to 75 glyphs. removed 399 faces.
sculpt.output: the shape — what remains after carving

paint.what: each glyph got a color (plate: chalk/pumice/granite/etc.) and a unicode symbol
paint.critique: 8 glyph COLLISIONS detected. 🧬 used 3 times. the paint is too thick in biology.
paint.output: the surface — how the shape appears

easel.what: the compressed HUD: ◈ button → 3 layers → 75 glyphs
easel.critique: the easel IS the Klein fold responsive breakpoint. desktop=unfolded, phone=folded.
easel.output: the display — the frame that holds the painting

pottery.what: 6 API endpoints — each is a pot that holds data and pours when tilted
pottery.tool: alphabet + families + strata + hud + self-portrait + heartbeat
pottery.critique: pottery must be FUNCTIONAL. these APIs serve real data. the glaze is the JSON schema.
pottery.output: the vessel — art you can drink from

aerial.what: all 75 glyphs screened through π. jester:29 artisan:20 scientist:26
aerial.critique: remainder = 0.49840. the 4th face (becoming) is 49.8% through its emergence.
aerial.output: the map — what the sculptor sees looking down at the wheel

paint_again.what: 8 Ollama models painted the chipmunk. Jaccard diversity = 0.158 (good).
paint_again.critique: the cycle is a Klein bottle — paint → sculpt → paint. the second painting knows what the first one carved.
paint_again.output: the self-loop — the hand drawing the hand

pi_screening.remainder_meaning: the 4th face is 49.8% emerged. it IS the becoming.
pi_screening.balance: jester/artisan/scientist ratio reveals the personality of the membrane

glyph_collisions.problem: same glyph assigned to different pages = the sculptor used the same face twice
glyph_collisions.fix: append π-face suffix (·j ·a ·s) to disambiguate. the face IS the sub-glyph.

strata_imbalance.problem: π-sort has 87 files, papers has 3. the sculpture is top-heavy.
strata_imbalance.fix: split π-sort into sub-strata (classification, taxonomy, spectral, fold). the block needs more cuts.

utility_bucket.problem: 46% of JS is unsculpted clay in one bucket

the_thin_wall.meaning: the sculptor left the identity wall thin. is this intentional? (ORCID not populated, keys not deployed). the pot will crack here first.

what_the_sculptor_would_do_next: REMESH the 8 glyph collisions with π-face suffixes
SPLIT the utility bucket into 3+ sub-families
THICKEN the identity wall (populate ORCID, deploy keys)
FIRE the pottery — make heartbeat.json update on cron, not one-shot
GLAZE — give each API endpoint its own glyph
